title: Physical Android installed-PWA certification
purpose: Certify the remaining mobile behaviors that browser/Node automation cannot reproduce: Android process death, installed-PWA relaunch, lifecycle persistence, and real update behavior.

scenarios.name: Cold start
instructions: Force-stop the installed PWA from Android app/site settings or terminate its process.
Launch Pursuit Iron from the installed home-screen icon.
Confirm the app reaches the first usable screen without a black screen, startup error, or endless loading state.
scenarios.expected: The installed app boots normally and reaches a usable React UI.

scenarios.name: Active workout survives process kill
instructions: Start a workout and log at least one completed set plus a note or changed input on a later set.
Background the PWA, then force-stop/kill it so the process is genuinely gone.
Relaunch from the installed icon and resume the workout.
scenarios.expected: The same program/day/week resumes; completed work and current inputs are preserved and exercise order still comes from the current program.

scenarios.name: Rest timer restoration
instructions: During a workout, start a rest timer and allow several seconds to elapse.
Background and kill the installed PWA process.
Relaunch and resume the workout.
scenarios.expected: The rest-timer state restores coherently without inventing elapsed training time or resetting logged work.

scenarios.name: Normal background/resume
instructions: Start a workout, log work, and background the app without force-stopping it.
Use another app long enough for Android to suspend Pursuit Iron.
Return to Pursuit Iron.
scenarios.expected: The live session returns without duplicate navigation, reset inputs, lost notes, or timer corruption.

scenarios.name: Offline relaunch
instructions: Open Pursuit Iron once while online so the current release is installed and cached.
Enable airplane mode or otherwise remove network access.
Kill the installed PWA and relaunch from the home-screen icon.
scenarios.expected: The cached app shell loads and locally stored training data remains available.

scenarios.name: Update while idle
instructions: With no workout active, deploy or make available a newer test build/service worker.
Open or foreground the installed PWA and wait for the update-ready control.
Use the in-app Restart action.
scenarios.expected: The new worker takes control through the app's Restart path, the app reloads successfully, and local training/history data survives.

scenarios.name: Update does not interrupt active workout
instructions: Begin a workout and log at least one set.
Make a newer service worker/build available while the workout is active or minimized.
Observe update UI and continue training before finishing or explicitly ending the session.
scenarios.expected: The update/restart action does not force an active workout to reload or discard live state. The workout remains usable and restorable.

scenarios.name: Deferred update after workout
instructions: Complete the workout used for the active-update scenario.
Accept the pending update/restart after the live workout is no longer active.
Verify the completed workout appears once in history after reload.
scenarios.expected: The update completes after the workout and the completed session/history is preserved exactly once.

scenarios.name: Device reboot storage persistence
instructions: Confirm at least one workout/history record and app setting are present.
Reboot the Android device.
Launch Pursuit Iron from the installed home-screen icon.
scenarios.expected: Training history, current program state, and persistent settings survive the device reboot.

scenarios.name: Rapid lifecycle stress
instructions: During a workout, repeatedly background/foreground the app several times, including locking/unlocking the phone once.
Change at least one weight/reps input between transitions.
Finish by returning to the workout normally.
scenarios.expected: No duplicate live sessions, overwritten inputs, navigation explosions, black screens, or loss of logged work occur.
